page.content:
Murdered king who becomes lord of the justified dead.

How Osiris connects

  • Character: Set — Set murdered Osiris and seized the kingship.
  • Event: Osiris myth — The Osiris myth is the murder and restoration of Osiris.
  • Character: Isis — Isis reassembled Osiris and made him king of the dead.
  • Location: Duat — Osiris judges and rules in the Duat.
  • Faction: Ennead — Osiris is one of the nine of Heliopolis.
  • Concept: Pharaoh — The dead pharaoh becomes Osiris in the tomb.
  • Character: Nephthys — Nephthys mourns Osiris and helps Isis restore him.

What is Osiris?

Osiris was slain and dismembered by Set, reassembled by Isis, and made ruler of the Duat. Every justified dead person hoped to become 'an Osiris.'

Key threads lead to Set, Osiris myth, Isis, Duat, Ennead and Pharaoh.
